c:attribute.name: level
c:attribute.description: The percentage that the shades are open (raised/lowered). May also be used to set how closed (lowered) or open (raised) the shade is where 100% is fully open and 0% is fully closed. For devices that only support being set fully Open (Raised) or Closed (Lowered), use 0% for Closed (Lowered) and 100% for Open (Raised).

c:attribute.name: shadestate
c:attribute.description: Reflects the current state of the shade. Obstruction implying that something is preventing the opening or closing of the shade.

c:attribute.name: movement
c:attribute.description: Which way the shade is moving: OPENING or CLOSING while a move the platform sent is under way, otherwise STOPPED, including when the driver can't tell the direction. level keeps its old value until the move ends. Not every driver reports it.

c:attribute.name: levelchanged
c:attribute.description: UTC time of last level change.

c:method.name: GoToOpen
c:method.description: Move the shade to a pre-programmed OPEN position.

c:method.name: GoToClosed
c:method.description: Move the shade to a pre-programmed CLOSED position.

c:method.name: GoToFavorite
c:method.description: Move the shade to a pre-programmed FAVORITE position.

c:method.name: Stop
c:method.description: Stop the shade where it is. level changes once the shade reports where it stopped. Only drivers that report movement support it.
